name: Alpha Divisions Public Company Limited
summary: Alpha Divisions Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the consultation and property development business in Thailand and internationally. The company involved in the hire purchase business of motorcycles, cars, gold, and agricultural equipment, as well as related investing activities; and manufacturing and distribution of precursor and chemicals from hemp and/or cannabis. It also engages in microfinance business; and invests in property development business. In addition, the company operates as a producer, distributor, and agent for selling electricity from solar energy, wind, water, and other businesses. The company was formerly known as Ocean Commerce Public Company Limited and changed its name to Alpha Divisions Public Company Limited in January 2022. Alpha Divisions Public Company Limited was founded in 2003 and is based in Bangkok, Thailand.
